ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos , bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Tudo começou quando Antônio José começou a trabalhar com seu pai como representante de materiais elétricos. Tendo que conciliar o trabalho com os estudos, Antônio José teve que abandonar a faculdade de Engenharia Civil e assumir os negócios com seu pai. Logo depois, seu amigo e cunhado, Cláudio Brasil, entrou na empresa, recém-formado em Engenharia Elétrica, e em 1977 decidiram formar sociedade e abrir uma empresa de comercialização de materiais e instalações elétricas.

A Normatel Home Center é expert quando o assunto é fazer com que o cliente se sinta em casa, sendo sinônimo de conforto. Tendo lojas com localizações estratégicas nos principais vetores de crescimento urbano: Fortaleza, Maracanaú e Juazeiro do Norte. O padrão de qualidade, a diversidade de produtos, uma equipe de profissionais treinados e centrados no atendimento e na satisfação do cliente são as constantes que nos guiam e nos impulsionam.

A Normatel Engenharia acumulou durante esses anos uma sólida base técnica e visão de mercado. Capacitada nos mais diversos segmentos de obras, construções e instalações, como indústrias, hospitais, shoppings, edifícios, aeroportos, portos, teatros e obras de restauração junto à iniciativa privada e às instituições públicas nas esferas municipal, estadual e federal.

A Normatel Incorporaçõe s foi fundada em 1989 com o nome de DN Empreendimentos Imobiliários até que em 2011 foi 100% incorporada ao Grupo Normatel. Ao longo desses anos, conquistou credibilidade e reconhecimento, através do cumprimento integral dos seus projetos e compromissos.

O CSC (Centro de Serviços Compartilhados ), engloba as áreas de gestão, de finanças, de contabilidade, do contencioso comercial, cível, tributário e trabalhista, de recursos humanos, dos sistemas informatizados e da tecnologia da informação e da manutenção de equipamentos, segurança e patrimônio físico de todas as empresas.

  • Elaborar o inventário de riscos como levantamento de perigos e riscos ocupacionais (LPRO) e análise de risco de tarefas (AST);
  • Realizar entrega de equipamentos de proteção aos colaboradores, seguindo os critérios de exposição de riscos das referidas atividades;

description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify pattern and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands‑on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

description:
Join to apply for the TEC SERVICOS OFFSHORE III role at TechnipFMC .

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

Responsible for planning, executing, and coordinating activities related to the operations/installation of equipment produced by TechnipFMC for national and international clients. This includes participating in the development of operational installation procedures, in collaboration with the team, to ensure that operations/installations are carried out in accordance with operational procedures, safety standards, and client requirements.

Job Description

  • Participate in briefing meetings with the coordination team regarding the planning of the operation to be carried out, in order to understand the procedures, resources, guidelines, and clarify any doubts.
  • Contribute to the creation of databases for field occurrences and deviations by providing information to the integrated SAP system (S1), suggesting actions and measures to eliminate anomalies.
  • Review documentation from previous operations through reports and study the procedures related to the upcoming operation, in order to be prepared to perform the assigned activities.
  • Participate in the development of operational procedures (OP) for the client Petrobras, detailing the specific steps of the operation to be carried out, aiming to obtain STO validation (client support), which will be shared with other stakeholders.
  • Receive, inspect, and verify the equipment mobilized and demobilized from offshore operations by checking the material lists, to ensure the system is intact and complies with all technical specifications, submitting this control to the client when requested.
  • Perform equipment assembly and testing based on TechnipFMC and client procedures, using the necessary resources to initiate operations.
  • Operate equipment according to operational procedures and safety standards, aiming to meet the demands of TechnipFMC and its clients.
  • Prepare weekly activity reports on SharePoint, detailing the tasks performed each day, in accordance with the established deadlines and content requirements, to ensure the provision of information for time-off tracking, additional payments, and departmental cost control.

Eligibility and Qualifications

  • Mechanical Technician Diploma.
  • Active CFT registration.
  • Fluent English.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Experience and Technical Skills

  • Offshore experience in well completion and intervention, leadership position for hardware scope.
  • Proven experience in installation/intervention (workover) of subsea equipment using EDP, LRP, UEH, and HPU (SCVS/DPR).
  • Proficient in installing equipment such as Tubing Head, Tubing Hanger, Subsea Christmas Tree, Tie-in, UTH, SDH, and others.

Base: Rio de Janeiro / Offshore

Company Values

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Responsibilities

  • Carry out service and maintenance tasks on turbochargers, both at company facilities and at customer sites in Brazil.
  • Execute specialized technical support in accordance with Accelleron workflows, quality standards, and safety guidelines to ensure superior customer experience and operational excellence.
  • Perform service tasks such as disassembly, cleaning, inspection, measurement and assembly of turbochargers, identify technical problems, and conduct remote and onsite analyses at workshops and field locations (ships, platforms, etc.) and thermoelectric plants. Perform installation, commissioning, maintenance, repairs, updates, renovations and replacements as required.
  • Maintain customer satisfaction by completing service work per customer orders and expectations, building good relationships, understanding customer needs, and identifying new sales opportunities.
  • Coordinate materials, parts and equipment to ensure availability and quality for service activities.
  • Prepare all necessary documents and reports to be signed by the customer representative, report work done promptly and follow up as needed. Conduct maintenance inspections and reporting, capture parts details and measurements.
  • Identify potential equipment failures proactively, troubleshoot failures, and recommend corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Propose suggestions for product and quality improvement, communicate findings within the organization and provide recommendations to management to enhance operations and customer service.
  • Apply safety rules, environmental responsibilities and quality processes; report unsafe practices and incidents.

Background & Qualifications

  • Technical training in Mechanics with an active CFT (Mechanical Technician Certificate).
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in maintenance and service of rotating machinery, engines, or preference for turbochargers and large combustion engines in the maritime sector.
  • Experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including use of precision measuring instruments, hand tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools.
  • Preferably certified or experienced in lifting operations, overhead crane handling, electric forklift operation, work at height, and compliance with industrial safety standards.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Planner, etc.).
  • Intermediate English language skills.
  • Availability for national and international travel to execute services and training.
  • Active driver’s license and passport.

Core Competencies

  • Familiarity with regulations and rules, following management guidelines.
  • Service and solution-oriented mindset, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Customer and results orientation.
  • Responsibility, autonomy, and commitment to safety.
  • Effective communication and teamwork.
  • Capability to perform well under emergency work demands.
  • Proactivity and continuous improvement mindset.

Job Conditions

  • Employment type: Full-time.
  • Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
  • Modality: Workshop and Field (customer site) activities, weekly schedule adapted to customer demand.
  • Flexibility to work outside normal business hours.
  • Required travel across Brazil and neighboring countries (Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Argentina).
  • Reports to: Workshop Manager.

Benefits

  • Profit sharing.

title: Diretor de Saúde e Segurança – Operações da América do Sul/Director, Health & Safety – South Am[...]
description:
Diretor de Saúde e Segurança – Operações da América do Sul/Director, Health & Safety – South American Operations

O Diretor Regional de Saúde e Segurança (Operações da América do Sul) é responsável por liderar e supervisionar a função de saúde e segurança em todos as operações e projetos na América do Sul. Essa função garante a implementação efetiva da estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança, impulsiona a melhoria contínua e promove uma cultura de segurança proativa alinhada com o compromisso da Pan American Silver em fazer "Segurança de forma Diferente ". O Diretor Regional trabalha em estreita colaboração com a liderança do local, as equipes corporativas de saúde e segurança e as equipes de projeto para prevenir ferimentos graves e fatalidades, garantir a conformidade regulatória e promover as melhores práticas.

Linha de relatório

  • Reporta-se a: Vice-Presidente de Saúde e Segurança
  • Localização: Residência na América do Sul necessária.
  • Viagens: 30-40% anualmente para locais de operação e desenvolvimento, muitas vezes em grandes altitudes ou regiões remotas da América do Sul
  • Reporte: Líderes de Saúde e Segurança das Operações/Projetos (Pontilhado/Matricial)

Principais responsabilidades

  • Implementar e supervisionar a estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança em todos os sites da América do Sul, com foco no gerenciamento de riscos críticos e prevenção de lesões graves e fatalidades: SIF (CRM, FIT/HOP, etc.)
  • Atuar como o principal elo de ligação entre a liderança das operações/projetos e o departamento corporativo de saúde e segurança.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver equipes de saúde e segurança no local, garantindo a execução eficaz de programas de gerenciamento de segurança e planos de ação
  • Colaborar com a liderança do local e do projeto para identificar, planejar e executar projetos de melhoria técnica e metas anuais de saúde e segurança
  • Garantir que planos robustos de resposta a emergências e sistemas de preparação estejam em vigor e sejam testados regularmente
  • Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação, diretrizes e políticas de saúde e segurança da empresa; comunicar atualizações e garantir a implementação de novos requisitos
  • Incentivar a comunicação e o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas com incidentes e eventos de alto potencial em todos os locais
  • Promover uma cultura de segurança como um valor fundamental, envolvendo as partes interessadas em todos os níveis e servindo como um líder visível na região.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a resposta à gestão de crises em nível regional
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios, métricas e recomendações de desempenho de segurança para líderes regionais e corporativos, incluindo relatórios mensais e trimestrais

Habilidades e experiência necessárias

  • 10+ anos de experiência em cargos de liderança em saúde e segurança na indústria de mineração, incluindo operações de sites na América Latina
  • Experiência comprovada na implementação de sistemas de gestão de segurança e garantia da conformidade com os padrões internacionais e locais de saúde e segurança

title: Sr. Clinical Operations Lead (LATAM)
description:
Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.

Project Liaison

  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study. Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.
  • First point of contact for regional CRAs for study-specific questions and issues. Escalates to PM and other functions as appropriate.
  • Support line managers by providing status updates on utilization and performance of CRAs.
  • Liaise with line manager for assigning sites to CRAs following line manager allocation of a CRA resource to the project.
  • Conduct CRA Assessment visits per departmental requirements to assess the performance of the CRA against their monitoring responsibilities.

Study Documents and Plans

  • Develop training materials and study tools for sites and CRAs, including monitoring plans.
  • Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies together with clinical project team.
  • Develop presentation materials for and presents at Sponsor Kickoff meetings, Investigator meetings and Sponsor Calls (as needed), and prepares presentations for Site Qualification Visits and Site Initiation Visits.

Qualifications

  • College diploma/degree AND 7-9 years related experience +continuous training and knowledge/skills upgrading
  • OR Undergraduate university degree (Bachelors or Honors Bachelors) AND 4-6 years\' experience + substantial on-going job-related training

Other

  • Health Sciences, Life Sciences or Nursing specialty preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation.
  • Should have a minimum of 3 years CRA experience, have strong experience with EDC systems, be proficient with MS Office, have strong written and verbal communication skills and highly effective interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrate the following attributes: proactive, detail oriented, task-driven and highly organized.
  • Demonstrate the critical elements of GCPs and local regulations as they relate to clinical monitoring, IRB/EC and Investigator responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability in report writing and strong ability to critically understand clinical research documents.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Working Conditions

  • Home-based

Harmonic is the worldwide leader in video delivery solutions, enabling media companies and service providers to deliver ultra-high-quality streaming and broadcast services to consumers globally. Through innovative SaaS platforms and software-based appliances, we are changing the way media companies and service providers monetize live and on-demand content on every screen. More information is available at

Description

We are looking for a Solutions Architect – Video Services to join the Harmonic Sales Team. You will report to the Sr. Director, LATAM Pre-Sales.

Location

Remote – You will be based anywhere in Latin America. US is an option, preferably EST time zone.

What You Will Be Doing

  • The Solutions Architect’s role is to be a technical evangelist for Harmonic’s cloud native broadcast, OTT, contribution, distribution solutions, and Server Side Ad Insertion – influencing and advising the technical decision makers within strategic accounts in our target markets. Primary customers are broadcast television networks, content owners and aggregators (Terrestrial, Satellite, Telco, OTT - Mobile and Internet), TV/movie studios, high-end enterprise video studios.
  • Work closely with account executives and partners to position and further Harmonic’s solutions through every aspect of the sales cycle – presentations, hands‑on demonstrations, RFI/RFP responses, design and architecture, bill of material and pricing. Work with current and prospective customers to generate winning solutions and systems designs, using the latest technologies in video delivery for live and time‑shifted video via traditional medium, or on the latest cloud infrastructure.
  • Ensure technical lead on proposals providing necessary support to meet sales goals.
  • Collaborate with partner vendors in designing solutions to meet customer needs.
  • Configure and test hardware and/or software products, including third party equipment such as network routers, blade servers, and storage systems to customer‑specific parameters in support of customer demos and proof of concepts.

What You Should Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Have a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in cloud technologies and 5+ years of video experience.
  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communications skills. Fluency in Spanish and English required, Portuguese is a plus.
  • Expertise in OTT, CDN, SSAI and associated technologies.
  • Expertise in cloud infrastructure, networking, and video delivery technologies. Analytical and troubleshooting skills in those areas.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership in system integration projects. Strong autonomy, analysis capacity, and sense of synthesis.
  • Good personal relationship skills, organized, with team‑building skills.
  • Cloud and containers environments: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, Mesos, Docker/Containers, and hybrid clouds.
  • Data Center technologies: VMware vSphere and Hyper‑V multi‑tenant data center infrastructure, including Infrastructure‑as‑a‑Service, Software‑as‑a‑Service, Platform‑as‑a‑Service.
  • Networking: SDN, IP routing (RIP, OSPF, BGP), IP multicast (ASM, SSM, PIM, IGMPv1/2/3), QoS (DiffServ, queuing), and switching. CCNA/CCNP is a plus.
  • Digital video system architectures from signal acquisition to delivery for IPTV, Cable and OTT.
  • MPEG‑2/MPEG‑4 (AVC)/HEVC video compression and encoding standards, stream processing, OTT HLS and MPEG‑DASH formats.
  • Interest in customer relations and services. Initiative and reactivity.
  • Broad systems and software knowledge required with significant technical depth in cloud deployment, virtualization, networking, video compression, playout, stream processing, video related applications, and servers & storage products.

Travel (if applicable)

You are required to travel about 30%.

At Harmonic, we believe that building and nurturing a global team with diverse backgrounds and voices is critical to our success. Together, we achieve excellence through creativity and innovation, build relationships based on integrity and mutual respect, and deliver the highest quality in every aspect of our business for the benefit of our employees, business partners and shareholders.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: PSICÓLOGO eMulti - AP 3.3
description:
Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica, bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde da família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Psicologia;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Preencher os requisitos daResolução SMS 4871 de 13 de Abril de 2021, a saber:

RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB) ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:

§1º Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.

§2º Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.

§3º Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).

§4º Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.

§5º Certificado de conclusão de residência ou pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde.

§6º Título de especialista reconhecido pela associação médica brasileira (AMB)

§7º Ter participado de 3 (três) atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas: Saúde da Família, Medicina, Saúde Pública e Saúde Coletiva (congressos, seminários, workshop, capacitações em cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos antes da contratação.

Additional information

Local de Trabalho: AP 3.3 - Madureira e Adjacências.

Carga Horária: 40 horas semanais.

Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.

Desde dezembro de 2024, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes.

Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por dados e gostaria de aplicar seus conhecimentos para criar modelos de predição focados em performance de negócios, essa vaga é para você!

Como Data Science Specialist , você irá atuar junto com um time multidisciplinar e apoio de áreas especializadas em Ciência de Dados, tendo a oportunidade de transformar dados em valor, além de resolver os mais diversos desafios, sempre idealizando e participando dos planejamentos junto ao Time de Produtos.

  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com a evolução das práticas de ciência de dados na empresa.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL e Python;
  • Experiência em conduzir análises quantitativas robustas e consistentes, desde a definição do problema até a apresentação dos resultados;
  • Habilidade para criar e apresentar storytelling de dados, traduzindo insights técnicos em linguagem acessível para diferentes públicos;
  • Capacidade de definir problemas de negócio claros e propor soluções baseadas em dados que gerem impacto real;
  • Comportamento colaborativo, com comunicação objetiva e abertura para diferentes pontos de vista;

  • Conhecimentos em modelos de Machine Learning de reconhecimento de imagens (OCR, identificação de objetos, identificação de ambientes e etc);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência com criação e desenvolvimento de produtos.

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

description:
Overview

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de SPM, para trabalhar de forma híbrida, sendo os dias presenciais no Rio de Janeiro ou em São Paulo.

Ao assumir o cargo de Analista de Dados Pleno na Afya, seu objetivo principal será identificar e analisar as principais dores de negócios, aplicando técnicas e conceitos adequados. Ele deve integrar-se ao cotidiano da área de negócios, promovendo a autonomia no uso de dados. Além disso, é importante incentivar o uso de uma fonte única de verdade, evitando shadow IT. O profissional também deve realizar análises combinadas de dados internos e externos, criando painéis estratégicos. É essencial disponibilizar dados de forma simples e estruturada para apoiar decisões. Por fim, deve interagir autonomamente com as áreas de negócios para aprender sobre os diversos produtos e serviços da empresa.

Inclusão

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Main responsibilities

  • Transformar perguntas de negócio em análises estratégicas , combinando SQL, planilhas e outras fontes, para orientar decisões críticas de produto, serviço e crescimento.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e o time de dados na criação de pipelines, scripts e processos que garantam qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos e experimentais (A/B tests, análises causais, hipóteses) para avaliar impacto de mudanças em produto e identificar oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards estratégicos em Power BI , priorizando clareza e impacto, e guiando discussões sobre tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Traduzir insights em storytelling executivo , conectando dados a narrativas claras e recomendações práticas para negócio e produto.
  • Entender profundamente o comportamento dos usuários , analisando engajamento, retenção e jornadas para antecipar melhorias de produto e apoiar decisões sobre novas features.
  • Analisar benchmarks e tendências de mercado , trazendo perspectivas externas que complementem os dados internos e apontem direções para inovação e competitividade.
  • Ser o ponto de contato confiável para áreas de negócio , disseminando conhecimento sobre métricas, catálogo de dados e boas práticas de governança.
  • Documentar e manter metadados, métricas e relatórios , garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade das informações usadas em decisões estratégicas.
  • Conduzir estudos analíticos ponta a ponta , do levantamento da necessidade até a comunicação de conclusões, influenciando priorização de roadmap e decisões de produto.
  • Zelar pela qualidade e integridade dos dados , propondo e implementando processos de monitoramento, validação e melhoria contínua.
  • Definir e refinar indicadores-chave de negócio , ajudando a empresa a medir o que realmente importa para crescimento sustentável.

Differenciais

  • dbt (modelagem modular, testes).
  • Airflow ou outra ferramenta de orquestração.
  • Databricks.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de produto (retenção, engajamento, funil, cohort).

Requirements and skills

  • SQL avançado (queries complexas, CTEs, funções janela).
  • Python para análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado.
  • Power BI (modelagem, DAX, dashboards).
  • Métodos estatísticos aplicados: amostragem, testes, intervalos de confiança, experimentos/A/B.
  • Noções de tracking de produto (Segment, GA4, Snowplow) e taxonomia de eventos.
  • Cloud Data Warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery ou Snowflake).

description:
Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Sitting within the Ticketing Department, Ticketing aims to deliver the most engaging, innovative, and accessible Women’s World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community.

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will help serve Ticketing sales, operations and efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil™ 2027 that for the first time ever, will be hosted in South America. Work in close consultation and collaboration with FIFA Zurich.

The Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive ticket sales strategies to ensure optimal attendance and revenue generation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 in Brazil. The role requires a strong understanding of the Brazilian sports market, exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to drive innovative ticketing initiatives not only across all 8 host cities but in the wider region.

Ensuring an exceptional and consistent approach in the planning phase as well as throughout the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and execute ticket sales strategies to maximize revenue and stadium occupancy across all venues.
  • Design and implement Ticket Sales Strategy for the project, including but not limited to ticket products, sales phases, and pricing strategies tailored to different market segments.
  • Conduct market analysis to optimise sales projections and adapt pricing dynamically.
  • Collaborate with the ticketing project management as well as the CRM team to ensure strategies and processes are aligned.
  • Collaborate with the FIFA Hospitality team and the Official Hospitality Provider to ensure Hospitality’s product positioning and pricing is integrated into the overall ticketing strategy and objectives.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de SPM, para trabalhar de forma híbrida sendo os dias presenciais no Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo.

Ao assumir o cargo de Analista de Dados Pleno na Afya , seu objetivo principal será identificar e analisar as principais dores de negócios, aplicando técnicas e conceitos adequados. Ele deve integrar-se ao cotidiano da área de negócios, promovendo a autonomia no uso de dados. Além disso, é importante incentivar o uso de uma fonte única de verdade, evitando shadow IT. O profissional também deve realizar análises combinadas de dados internos e externos, criando painéis estratégicos. É essencial disponibilizar dados de forma simples e estruturada para apoiar decisões. Por fim, deve interagir autonomamente com as áreas de negócios para aprender sobre os diversos produtos e serviços da empresa.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Main responsibilities

  • Transformar perguntas de negócio em análises estratégicas , combinando SQL, planilhas e outras fontes, para orientar decisões críticas de produto, serviço e crescimento.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e o time de dados na criação de pipelines, scripts e processos que garantam qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos e experimentais (A/B tests, análises causais, hipóteses) para avaliar impacto de mudanças em produto e identificar oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards estratégicos em Power BI , priorizando clareza e impacto, e guiando discussões sobre tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Traduzir insights em storytelling executivo , conectando dados a narrativas claras e recomendações práticas para negócio e produto.
  • Entender profundamente o comportamento dos usuários , analisando engajamento, retenção e jornadas para antecipar melhorias de produto e apoiar decisões sobre novas features.
  • Analisar benchmarks e tendências de mercado , trazendo perspectivas externas que complementem os dados internos e apontem direções para inovação e competitividade.
  • Ser o ponto de contato confiável para áreas de negócio , disseminando conhecimento sobre métricas, catálogo de dados e boas práticas de governança.
  • Documentar e manter metadados, métricas e relatórios , garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade das informações usadas em decisões estratégicas.
  • Conduzir estudos analíticos ponta a ponta , do levantamento da necessidade até a comunicação de conclusões, influenciando priorização de roadmap e decisões de produto.
  • Zelar pela qualidade e integridade dos dados , propondo e implementando processos de monitoramento, validação e melhoria contínua.
  • Definir e refinar indicadores-chave de negócio , ajudando a empresa a medir o que realmente importa para crescimento sustentável.

Requirements and skills

  • SQL avançado (queries complexas, CTEs, funções janela).
  • Python para análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado.
  • Power BI (modelagem, DAX, dashboards).
  • Métodos estatísticos aplicados: amostragem, testes, intervalos de confiança, experimentos/A/B.
  • Noções de tracking de produto (Segment, GA4, Snowplow) e taxonomia de eventos.
  • Cloud Data Warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery ou Snowflake).

Diferenciais

  • dbt (modelagem modular, testes).
  • Airflow ou outra ferramenta de orquestração.
  • Databricks.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de produto (retenção, engajamento, funil, cohort).

ROLE:

As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of 5-10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll-stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America's top real estate leaders. This is a player-coach leadership role where you'll spend 60-80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20-40% hands-on designing complex projects.

You'll own design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured not by how many thumbnails you design, but by how well your team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success.

This role is perfect for someone who loves developing designers as much as designing itself - someone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, this isn't the right fit.

Apply now:

  • Handle hiring (writing JDs, screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making offers)

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10-20% of role)

  • Data-driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization
  • Strong presentation skills for client-facing strategy calls and executive meetings
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting)

Communication & Cultural Leadership

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition

RESULTS:

Team Performance

  • Your design team consistently maintains 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New designers productive at 80% capacity within 30-60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • Agency-wide thumbnail CTR averages 5-10% (significantly above platform benchmarks)
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Your team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency-wide adoption

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with design insights that drive performance
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication
  • At least 1-2 designers promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function

  • Medical, Vision, Dental Benefits (employer-subsidized, starts after 60-90 day trial)
  • Flexible PTO policy, professional development budget, home office stipend

Growth Path

Performance Metrics You'll Own

Knwn Local helps America's top real estate leaders (ranked by Wall Street Journal Real Trends) attract more clients and grow their brands through strategic YouTube presence. Our clients manage $30M-$300M+ real estate teams and brokerages.

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Company Overview


If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!


Role Summary


The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. The FST offers real‑time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites, providing world‑class service and creating lasting competitive advantage.


Responsibilities



  • Perform direct, in‑person service calls in response to customer requests.

  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly.

  • Work side‑by‑side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required.

  • Supervise the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly.

  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule.

  • Check equipment before commissioning and start‑up and evaluate performance during and after start‑up.

  • Monitor the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment.

  • Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products.

  • Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering.

  • Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged.

  • Other duties as assigned.


Requirements



  • Mechanical Technician with active CFT.

  • Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry.

  • Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in installing mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc.

  • Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference.

  • Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges.

  • Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.

  • Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills.

  • Intermediate English.

  • An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job.

  • Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods.

  • Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers.

  • Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.


Desirable Skills



  • Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable.

  • Professional certifications in this area.


About Flowserve


Flowserve is a world‑leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000+ employees in 50+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges itself to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.


Equal Employment Opportunity


EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co‑workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision. description:
Sobre nós

Com mais de 200 marcas vendidas em quase 180 países, somos a empresa líder mundial em bebidas premium.
